THE RECKONING — 17 NOVEMBER 1936 — PRIVATE

9 p.m. Dinner.
Before 2 a.m. Go down by the seam, in the order of sitting. The housekeeper to remain above.
At 2:17 the library clock is set and let strike. The counterweight takes the seam door shut behind us; it will open again when the count is done.
The Record is read by Knowledge, confirmed by each chair in turn, and — for the first time since 1871 — witnessed.

VOTES ON THE MOTION TO CONTINUE: Vale, aye. Hawthorne, aye. Blackwood, aye. Whitmore (Medicine), NO — "I will go down. I will not count." Ashcroft, aye. Bell, aye. Mercer, aye.

WITNESS: Miss Eleanor Orrin, by invitation of E. Vale. Expected by the last train.
